title: AI debating trading app experiment
author: Electrical_Chard3255
selftext:
I thought it would be interesting to create an experiemnt to see how ai debating works in trading, this is specifically for bitcoin and crypto trading,

https://preview.redd.it/er3wsf6uqwkh1.png?width=1063&format=png&auto=webp&s=bf9350cc483389ce95fa66e07a1322edaf9b44de

So 3 AI debating together every 4 hours (or on an alarm, i.e. a large price movement) coming to a consensus and acting on it.

I also added several other "rivals" for alternative trading styles, hover over the rivals cards to get the explanation.

This is just a fun experiment currently, its running 24 hours a day, and we are now into day 2

Interesting to see where this goes, the AI should learn over time, they get a reputation and experience points over time that the other AI will act on, so its a dynamic experiment, however the AI remember nothing between cycles, but they are given a character sheet every cycle of the ai built up reputation to work with.

Any improvements, or suggestions are welcome, and I will concider them.
